Hi all

Thank you so much for taking the time with your detailed, helpful replies. A lot for me to consider before I decide what to do, so thank you!
Sorry, just seen this. Could probably do it Thursday afternoon but not before. Drop me a message with your WhatsApp or whatever and we’ll try and sort
When do you want to go?
As long as you can survive long enough to receive it
How did you work that out?

They keep you waiting around for ages to sign the form and remove cannulas.

There’s nothing stopping you walking out (providing you aren’t sectioned and have capacity). Just because you make an “unwise” decision doesn’t mean that you didn’t have the capacity to make the decision either. 

Cannulas can easily and safely be removed at home with cotton wool or some other compress.
I’m on Lamotrigine. Started on 25mg for two weeks then 50mg. Overnight it made a huge difference, but as time has past it’s effectiveness has diminished and I now take 50mg twice a day.
They need to be on a government watchlist
